Hi, I'm Abigail

Data Scientist

Data Scientist with a background in biochemistry, pharmaceutical quality assurance and customer analytics. I am currently completing an MSc in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at the University of Hull where I build end-to-end machine learning pipelines, deep learning models and data visualisations across real-world datasets spanning road safety, healthcare, NLP and customer behaviour.

Presently, I am optimizing transformer-based models such as Roberta to explore consumer sentiment toward AI-generated advertising and its impact on brand perception using NLP techniques to analyse real-world discourse across multiple marketing campaigns.

Previous projects led to measurable outcomes including a 30% improvement in business growth, a 96.7% accurate churn classifier using Power BI and multi-domain recommendations drawn from 370,000 UK road accident records. I bring a rigorous, data driven approach shaped by experience in regulated pharmaceutical environments, academic research and fast paced technology organisations.

Python · Data Science

UK Road Traffic Accident Analysis (2017 to 2019)

Analysed 370,153 DfT STATS19 accident records to uncover the conditions and patterns driving UK road accidents, using temporal analysis, geospatial clustering, association rule mining, and time series forecasting.

DBSCAN SARIMA Apriori scikit-learn statsmodels pandas
  • Serious accidents associate with fine weather & dry roads, not bad conditions
  • Peak risk: 08:00 and 15:00 to 18:00 weekdays (commuting, not weather)
  • Bradford & Leeds identified as top West Yorkshire accident hotspots

Python · Data Science · NLP

Automated News Text Classification — AG News Dataset

Compared 4 classification approaches from Naïve Bayes to Bidirectional LSTM on 120,000 news articles across 4 categories, executing 32 hyperparameter configurations to identify where and why performance gains occur across the full ML to deep learning spectrum.

Naïve Bayes LinearSVC Word2Vec CNN BiLSTM TF-IDF scikit-learn TensorFlow
  • Accuracy progression: 88% (Naïve Bayes) → 89% (SVM) → 91% (CNN) → 92% F1 (BiLSTM)
  • Deep learning advantage over well-tuned classical models: real but modest at 3 to 4 points
  • GridSearchCV across 24 combinations for classical models; randomised search across 8 for neural architectures
